prompt: Build a 5-qubit circuit implementing, as a general-purpose circuit block: Hadamard on all 5 qubits, then the phase exp(-i*gamma*H) where H = 0.2*Z0 + 0.3*Z1 - 0.1*Z2 + 0.4*Z3 - 0.3*Z4 + 0.3*Z0*Z1 + 0.4*Z1*Z2 - 0.2*Z2*Z3 + 0.5*Z3*Z4 (single-qubit field terms on every qubit, plus a chain of coupling terms between adjacent qubits). gamma = 0.4. This circuit will be transpiled for a 5-qubit LINEAR coupling map (qubit i only physically adjacent to qubit i-1 and i+1) — every coupling term here is already between adjacent qubits. IMPORTANT constraint: use ONLY the gates RZ, SX (square-root-X), X, and CX. Do NOT use H directly — decompose it into this gate set. No measurement.
